description:
Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok E-commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 6 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:


 Support the creator education strategy for TikTok Shop, including the design and production of educational content (videos, guides, tutorials) aimed at improving content quality and platform knowledge.
 Set up, write, and execute creator communications across channels such as Push, Inbox, WhatsApp, and Email, including copywriting, message setup, and campaign deployment, ensuring proper segmentation, clarity, and performance focus (CTR, OR).
 Own the management and day-to-day operations of WhatsApp creator communities, including content sharing, moderation, follow-ups, and coordination around key initiatives.
 Collaborate closely with content agencies to coordinate deliverables, review scripts, provide feedback, and ensure alignment with marketing and performance objectives.
 Support the execution and follow-up of key TikTok Shop campaigns (e.g., competitions, missions, and special initiatives), ensuring educational and communication materials are correctly implemented across channels.
 Research and analyze creator education and marketing strategies from other markets to propose improvements and adaptations.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related major.
 Strong interest in digital content, creator marketing, TikTok, and the e-commerce ecosystem.
 Solid communication skills, strategic thinking, and a results-oriented mindset.
 Experience or strong interest in content production (video, scripting, copywriting), ideally with familiarity with TikTok-style content.


Preferred Qualifications:


 Familiarity with TikTok content ecosystem, shoppable content, and brand-creator partnerships is a plus


For TikTok

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
Associate (Intern) - General Merchandise 

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.


Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. 
Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. 
Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. 
Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. 
Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. 
Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 


What will you be doing? 

This internship is designed for students to get hands-on, real-world experience working with a Client Development Team. The internship is for rising year 3 students, interested in pursuing a career in Insights, Analytics, CPG, Retail, Gen Merch or Market Research post-graduation.

Circana offers a full program to ensure ALL our associates gain:


Knowledge about the industry we exist in and the clients we serve. 
Experience working on active projects that have actual impact on our business. 
Training on technical tools and behavioral skills that are critical to an employee’s success. 
Networking and mentor opportunities that can create personal connections. 


Job Responsibilities


Support a team responsible for helping a General Merchandise client (or multiple clients) understand their performance relative to the market and identify opportunities to grow their business and share of the market. 
Understand how to leverage Circana analytics to address clients’ business challenges and market opportunities. 
Translate data into actionable, analytic insights to drive Circana’s clients’ business performance. 
Shadow client meetings to present market research and insights. 
At Circana lateral, promotional, and cross-functional moves are encouraged and part of our culture. While your initial role will be in one of these groups, you’ll have the chance to grow your career both within your initial assignment and into other opportunities that meet your career goals. 


Requirements


Pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree required in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field with a quantitative component, expecting to graduate between June 2027 and December 2027. 
Experience in or knowledge of the Retail or CPG industry preferred (e.g., School projects, case study, or relevant work experience). 
Academic knowledge/coursework in finance, economics, statistics, marketing or marketing analytics, data visualization, and/or logic is preferred. 
Strong intellectual curiosity and critical thinking ability, relentless attention to detail, strong written/verbal communication, ability to work collaboratively on a team, etc. 
Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus but not essential. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, etc.)
Technology aptitude and willingness to learn and work on new solutions and platforms. 
Creative problem-solving skills, ability to frame a business problem, design and execute an analysis plan, and understand and synthesize data findings into business insights and translate into creative data visualizations. 


Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:


Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 


Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid, Mexico City, Mexico

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

About The Role And Team

Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As a CRM Marketing Associate, you will join the Global CRM team to bridge digital and real worlds, powering movement by showing millions of consumers the tangible impact of our products. You will lead the strategy and execution of acquisition campaigns across owned digital channels at a global scale.

This role is not about polished marketing; it’s about navigating the messiness of global expansion and program scaling. You will need a "go-get-it" attitude and a mindset built for ownership and adaptability as you move fast to respond to the needs of our growing membership base. If you are energized by the challenge of driving experimentation and reporting results under high-pressure conditions, this is where you’ll grow.

What You’ll Do


Develop and execute global end-to-end CRM strategies focused on acquisition overall expansion in a high-stakes environment.
Navigate the complexity of marketing automation tools to build transactional, promotional, and informational content that converts users.
Scale campaigns across new countries, balancing the need for speed with the messiness of local market requirements.
Unblock growth by developing learning agendas, moving from experimentation planning to global scaling.
Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and regional ops teams to identify consumer insights and influence strategy without direct authority.
Own campaign performance end-to-end, reporting on KPIs and adjusting your approach based on shifting priorities and business needs.


Basic Qualifications


4+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer communications, or the customer engagement space.
Experience with marketing automation tools and multi-channel campaign management (email, push, in-app).
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.


Preferred Qualifications


Proven track record of delivering business results through A/B testing and experimentation at scale.
Strong systems thinking approach with a fervent interest in how tech stacks empower CRM solutions.
Ability to thrive in ambiguity and manage multiple stakeholders to remove structural roadblocks.
Excellent project management skills with a rigorous attention to detail and swift execution.


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. About The Company

Our client is a startup SaaS platform that works as an operating system for small businesses in the US. It helps founders form their LLC and then keeps it compliant over time, all in one place. It operates in all 50 states.

On the formation side, the platform handles the LLC filing, EIN, operating agreement, business templates and the first year of registered agent service. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Crunchyroll is seeking a Senior Manager, CRM Marketing to lead localized CRM engagement for our Latin American markets, one of our fastest-growing regions. Based in Mexico City, this role will own the CRM campaign calendar for the region, balancing high-velocity title moments and catalog beats while bringing our biggest anime moments to life across owned channels.

You will plan and execute high-impact, fan-first campaigns that support title launches and catalog discovery—including new season/series drops, dub drops, mid-season arcs, and finales for top-tier titles. Success in this role requires strong segmentation and analytical judgment, plus the ability to translate IP into messaging that creates an emotional connection with fans.

You’ll also act as a subject matter expert for the Latin America market, championing transcreation and locally resonant storytelling (not just translation), cultural nuance, and fan-first engagement. You’ll partner closely with our global Lifecycle Marketing team that owns always-on lifecycle journeys; in this role, you will serve as a regional advisor and ensure key title moments and local insights are reflected in the broader lifecycle strategy.

Own content-triggered messaging strategy that supports title moments and engagement in alignment with lifecycle standards and guardrails.

Position Type: Full-Time, Fully Remote

About The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Content & Growth Marketing Specialist to drive content creation, audience growth, and marketing execution.

You will work directly with the founder, who will provide the overall strategy and weekly mentorship. Your role will be to turn ideas, interviews, and business insights into engaging content, manage paid advertising campaigns, grow relevant audiences, and identify opportunities that convert attention into meaningful business conversations.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys creating, experimenting, analyzing results, and taking ownership of growth initiatives.

What You'll Own

Content Creation & Personal Branding


Interview the founder regularly and turn conversations, ideas, and experiences into engaging content.
Create and publish posts, short-form clips, newsletters, and videos across LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
Develop content that builds credibility, increases visibility, and attracts relevant audiences.
Repurpose existing content into multiple formats to maximize reach and engagement.


Paid Advertising & Creative Testing


Produce advertising creatives in volume using different formats, angles, and messaging.
Launch and manage paid advertising campaigns across relevant platforms.
Run creative and audience tests to identify what generates the best results.
Monitor campaign performance, optimize spending, and scale successful campaigns.


Newsletter Management


Draft, manage, and publish newsletters for different audience segments.
Manage a local newsletter used as a testing ground for new growth and marketing techniques.
Experiment with content, messaging, and distribution strategies to improve subscriber growth and engagement.


Audience Growth & Partnerships


Execute outreach campaigns to attract new subscribers and grow relevant audiences.
Identify and develop partnership and sponsorship opportunities.
Build relationships with communities and networks relevant to the company's target customers.
Find opportunities to increase brand awareness and generate inbound conversations.


Performance Tracking & Reporting


Track key metrics, including reach, engagement, subscriber growth, leads, and meetings booked.
Analyze campaign and content performance to understand what is working and why.
Provide regular updates on progress, results, and areas for improvement.
Use performance data to guide future content and growth strategies.


Requirements


Experience in content marketing, social media growth, personal branding, or digital marketing.
Strong writing skills with the ability to create clear, engaging, and natural-sounding content.
Experience creating content for LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
Understanding of paid advertising, creative testing, and campaign optimization.
Experience managing newsletters, audience growth, and outreach campaigns.
Comfortable using AI tools to improve content production, research, and marketing workflows.
Ability to track performance metrics and make data-driven decisions.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives independently.
Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to reporting progress and raising blockers.


Nice to Have


Experience growing a founder's personal brand or an executive's online presence.
Familiarity with AI, automation, SaaS, or technology-focused businesses.
Experience with video editing, short-form content, and content repurposing.
Experience building newsletters, online communities, or partnership programs.
Knowledge of marketing automation and AI-powered content workflows.


What Makes You a Strong Fit


Execution-focused: You take ideas from concept to publication and make sure every task is completed.
Ownership mentality: You take responsibility for outcomes rather than waiting for instructions.
AI-driven: You use AI tools daily to increase output without compromising quality.
Customer-focused: You understand customer conversations, feedback, and the language buyers actually use.
Analytical: You enjoy working with numbers and figuring out why certain campaigns or content perform better.
Highly communicative: You consistently share progress, blockers, and potential risks.
Growth-minded: You want to develop into someone who can independently lead content and growth initiatives.


Interview Process


Initial screening with Pavago.
Client interview.
Final selection and onboarding.

Job Description

Marketing Analyst | EF Language Abroad

What if your next role actually changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Marketing Analyst to join our team in Polanco, Mexico. This is your chance to grow your career in a global company, work alongside an energetic and ambitious team, and help shape the way young people discover life changing experiences abroad.

You'll be at the heart of our digital presence: creating content, managing campaigns, and turning data into insights that drive real results. No two days look the same, just creative work, real impact, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one.

Your Main Responsibilities

Digital Marketing


 Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, and other digital channels. 
 Manage the brand's social media channels, including content scheduling, posting, and community engagement. 
 Monitor campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations. 


Content Creation


 Develop engaging content for social media, email marketing, blogs, and other digital platforms. 
 Support the creation and localization of global marketing materials for the local market. 
 Review and ensure all content is aligned with brand guidelines and tone of voice. 


Analytics and Reporting


 Track and report on key marketing KPIs, providing regular performance updates to the team. 
 Use data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 
 Support A/B testing and other optimization initiatives. 


Collaboration


 Work closely with the sales team to align marketing efforts with business goals. 
 Collaborate with global marketing teams to adapt and localize campaigns. 
 Support the planning and execution of events and promotional actions. 


Requirements


 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 
 Previous experience in digital marketing or content creation. 
 Proficiency in English. Additional languages are a plus. 
 Hands on experience with social media management tools, CRM, and analytics platforms. 
 Strong eye for design and familiarity with tools like Canva, Adobe, or equivalent. 
 Data driven mindset with strong analytical and communication skills. 
 Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast paced international environment. 


Why You Will Love Working with Us

More than just a job, we offer a career, and the benefits grow with you.

From Day One, All EF Team Members Enjoy


 Benefits by local law 
 Corporate benefits discounts 
 Staff referral bonus (500 USD) 
 EF Hello App 
 Access to the Mental Health App "Foundation" 


As a Marketing Analyst, You Also Unlock


 Global Mobile Office 
 National KO recognition 
 EF Summer Helper Nomination: 1 week as a group helper abroad 
 Famtrip Nomination: travel to the USA 


As you grow through our career ladder, even more doors open. Depending on your level, you may also unlock:


 Intercontinental Famtrip nominations 
 Free language courses and international training nominations 
 Hub Office visits with training and networking opportunities 
 Leadership development programs and international kickoffs 


 Benefits vary by career level and are subject to local labor laws and business eligibility criteria. 

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe.

We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. Through blending classroom-based lessons with interactive exercises and real-world practice, our courses bring you to the heart of the language. Together, our global staff help students from around the world develop the language skills they need to achieve their dreams.

EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable.

Job Title: Digital Product Optimization - Experimentation strategy lead

Work Location: Remote -Mexico

Working hours - 9 AM to 5 PM EST

Interview: Video 3 rounds




Digital Product Optimization - Experimentation strategy lead

About the team

Digital Product Optimization is a shared services and Center of Excellence team that enables A/B testing and experimentation horizontally across a large, consumer facing digital organization. We provide education, consultation, strategy, and delivery services for experiments, working with product teams across a portfolio of high traffic websites and mobile applications.

Our mission is to make experimentation a core component of how products get built. We work on live, in market experiences, helping teams gather evidence before they commit to building a feature and helping them optimize what they have just launched.




About the role

The Experimentation Strategy Lead is the subject matter expert who sits at the intersection of product management, design, engineering, and analytics. You will partner with a portfolio of roughly 10 to 12 product teams, taking their ideas and helping them become viable, trustworthy experiments.

This is a highly collaborative, partner facing role. Approximately 75 percent of your time is spent working directly with the teams we support. You own the discovery and planning phases of the experimentation lifecycle, from first conversation through to a fully specified, aligned test that is ready to be handed to our delivery function for execution.




What you will do

• Engage and educate product teams that are new to experimentation, and build their confidence in the practice.

• Consult with engaged teams to develop experimentation roadmaps that support and strengthen their product roadmaps.

• Evaluate incoming test requests for technical, statistical, and strategic feasibility, working with analytics and engineering partners to confirm what is possible.

• Facilitate strategic refinement of experiments, including sharpening hypotheses, validating the measurement approach, and confirming design assets are aligned and delivered.

• Build consensus across cross functional partners, and constructively challenge proposals when a stronger test design exists.

• Guide roughly a dozen concurrent experiments through the front end of our delivery process and hand them off cleanly for execution.

• Run recurring cross functional working sessions alongside your product partner meetings to keep work moving.

• Contribute to the team’s education and enablement materials, including playbooks, curriculum, and workshops.

• Translate complex analytical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for product managers who are not analytics specialists.




What we are looking for

Required

• Three to five years or more of focused experimentation experience, either as a dedicated specialist or in a product role where A/B testing was practiced rigorously, supported by a broader professional background.

• Strong data acumen, including a solid working grasp of experimental design, sample sizing, statistical significance, and test validity, and the ability to explain them clearly to non specialists.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with genuine attention to detail and a conscientious approach to keeping partners informed.

• Demonstrated ability to build consensus, influence without authority, and bridge gaps between teams with differing views.

• Experience in consumer facing (B2C) digital products with meaningful traffic volume.

• Comfort operating in a shared service or internal consulting model, managing a portfolio of stakeholders at once.

• Availability to work consistently within US Eastern or US Pacific business hours.




Preferred

• Experience in a large, complex enterprise environment.

• Exposure to both web and mobile app experimentation.

• Working familiarity with digital analytics and experience intelligence platforms such as Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare.

• Contextual familiarity with an enterprise experimentation platform such as Adobe Target or Optimizely.

• Background in conversion rate optimization, growth, or marketing product management.

• Some instructional design or enablement experience.

• Experience in travel, hospitality, entertainment, or destination commerce.

• Prior Disney experience with Product Management/ Experimentation teams




Good to know

• This is a strategy and consulting role rather than a hands on build role. You will not be configuring experiments in the testing platform.

• You will partner closely with analytics specialists who own the formal analysis. You need to be fluent enough to ask sharp questions and interpret results, not to run the analysis yourself.

• A dedicated delivery owner takes each experiment through build and launch once your planning work is complete.

Description

We're seeking a data-driven marketing professional to drive customer growth for Amazon Mexico's categories through lifecycle and outbound marketing, and to own the reporting that powers our Category Marketing team. This role combines deep analytical expertise with hands-on channel management to acquire, engage and retain customers across our business groups. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an exciting, fast-growing business.

The successful candidate will develop and execute lifecycle and outbound strategies (Push, Email, WhatsApp) that move customers through the funnel, from acquisition and first purchase to repeat purchase, Prime adoption and retention. They will act as the bridge between marketing channel owners and category teams, translating category needs into campaigns and programs and bringing company-wide priorities to category teams. They will also own the team's BI and reporting mechanisms, standardizing the metrics category teams use in their weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical and SQL skills, a test-and-learn mindset, and the ability to simplify and scale through automation and AI. They communicate clearly across functions and levels, thrive with ambiguity and changing priorities, and enjoy a highly entrepreneurial environment. We are seeking someone with a proven track record in channel management, experimentation and project management.

Key job responsibilities

Lead category lifecycle strategy: analyze each category's customer funnel (active customers, new customer acquisition, repeat purchase, Prime adoption), present insights to category stakeholders, and plan and launch category-specific lifecycle initiatives.

Act as the point of contact for category-specific and company-wide lifecycle and Prime initiatives, coordinating execution with lifecycle and Prime teams.

Own category outbound marketing (Push, Email, WhatsApp): create campaigns for company priorities and major and seasonal events, ensure campaigns hit goals, and optimize performance across categories.

Drive experimentation across free outbound channels and WhatsApp, including customer acquisition and Prime tests. Document learnings and scale what works.

Own BI and reporting for the Category Marketing team: standardize weekly, monthly and quarterly metrics for category business reviews, with category-level drill-downs and visibility for all teams.

Deliver deep dives on campaign and funnel performance, with clear recommendations to category and marketing teams.

Increase category team adoption of lifecycle self-service tools, including engagement and gamification programs.

Lead efficiencies through AI and automation: semi-automated campaigns, automated reports and faster asset creation.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Lifecycle, Prime, Category Management, Vendor Management and BI teams.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Experience in a marketing role and proficient with analytic tools
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience in a marketing role
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Knowledge of analytic tools
 Experience using integrated campaigns to solve brand/business challenges

title: GTM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

She/he acts as an entrepreneur in his/her country, building and nurturing most engaged teams, working with the best and most innovative partners, constantly fostering media innovation and development of business opportunities in consumer communication and interaction through digital and traditional media channels.

STRATEGIC MEDIA DIRECTION & PLANNING

Develops, executes, and monitors the country’s strategic media direction. Builds year-round engagement plans to reach and engage evolving consumer audiences. Identifies opportunities to adapt the strategy based on market changes and audience behavior.

Has a deep understanding and passion for the product and Red Bull’s target audiences. Understands local consumers’ media consumption habits and the broader media landscape. Uses audience insights to develop relevant and effective engagement strategies.

DATA, INSIGHTS & PERFORMANCE MONITORING

Uses ongoing data insights and reporting to monitor performance in real time. Identifies shifts in audience behavior and media consumption. Adjusts the media approach and strategy based on insights and performance.

PRODUCTION & CONTENT NETWORK

Builds and maintains a strong network of production companies and creative talent. Works closely with videographers, directors, photographers, and other content creators to bring ideas and stories to life.

GLOBAL & LOCAL ALIGNMENT

Ensures alignment between the local team and global audience and media strategies. Works across product, events, opinion leaders/influencers, athlete, and dancer projects. Adapts global strategies and initiatives into hyper-local plans that are relevant to the local audience.

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent - even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We've started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

Sobre S2G Energy

S2G Energy es una empresa mexicana especializada en soluciones tecnológicas de eficiencia energética y movilidad eléctrica. A través de una plataforma integral y dispositivos IoT, ayudamos a clientes industriales y comerciales a monitorear, analizar y optimizar el consumo de energía, agua y gas, así como a gestionar y entender el uso de infraestructura de carga para vehículos eléctricos.

Nuestra tecnología centraliza y correlaciona datos energéticos, operativos y de movilidad eléctrica, conectando el desempeño energético con la realidad del negocio y permitiendo la toma de decisiones con impacto económico, operativo y sustentable.

Nuestro propósito es Facilitar la Independencia Energética Sustentable en todo el Mundo a través de la tecnología.




Objetivo del Puesto

Como Customer Success Analyst, formarás parte del equipo responsable de ejecutar análisis técnicos, energéticos y de negocio que soportan la entrega de valor de nuestras soluciones con clientes.

Esta posición está diseñada como un rol entry-level, ideal para recién egresados o perfiles con experiencia profesional temprana que buscan desarrollarse en el sector energético, analítica, tecnología e innovación aplicada al negocio.

Buscamos a una persona activa, curiosa, rápida para aprender y ejecutar, con interés genuino por el uso de inteligencia artificial, automatización y nuevas tecnologías para mejorar procesos, análisis, comunicación con clientes y desarrollo comercial.

Trabajarás con acompañamiento y mentoría del equipo senior, desarrollando habilidades en análisis energético, infraestructura eléctrica, uso práctico de herramientas digitales, visualización de datos, preparación de propuestas técnico-comerciales y comunicación con clientes. Conforme avances, asumirás mayor autonomía y responsabilidad en proyectos reales, participando también en iniciativas de marketing, business development y generación de materiales estratégicos para clientes.




Competencias

Base técnica en energía e infraestructura eléctrica, incluyendo conceptos de consumo, potencia, demanda, medición y eficiencia energética.
Capacidad para leer e interpretar diagramas unifilares y layouts a nivel básico–intermedio.
Habilidades analíticas y matemáticas para análisis estadísticos básicos, modelado energético inicial e identificación de patrones de consumo.
Conocimiento básico o interés práctico en herramientas de análisis de datos como SQL, Python, Power Query o similares, para apoyar en limpieza, revisión y automatización sencilla de información.
Familiaridad con Power BI, Excel avanzado u otras herramientas de visualización de datos para construir, actualizar o interpretar dashboards, con guía del equipo senior.
Interés activo en el uso de inteligencia artificial para mejorar análisis, automatizar tareas, generar insights, preparar materiales y aumentar la productividad del equipo.
Capacidad para apoyar en la elaboración de propuestas comerciales, presentaciones ejecutivas, materiales para clientes y casos de negocio.
Mentalidad versátil y colaborativa para apoyar en actividades de Customer Success, Marketing, Business Development y operación comercial cuando sea necesario.
Organización, atención al detalle, comunicación clara, pensamiento estructurado y orientación a resultados.
Proactividad, autonomía progresiva, aprendizaje rápido y disposición para trabajar en un entorno dinámico y de alta exigencia.




Funciones Principales

Apoyar el análisis de datos energéticos, operativos y de movilidad eléctrica para identificar patrones, desviaciones y oportunidades de eficiencia.
Construir, actualizar e interpretar dashboards en Power BI, Excel u otras herramientas de visualización, apoyando en la definición de KPIs, métricas clave y visualizaciones para clientes.
Analizar información técnica como diagramas unifilares, layouts, históricos de consumo y datos operativos, con acompañamiento del equipo senior.
Utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial para acelerar análisis, documentar hallazgos, generar reportes, estructurar propuestas y mejorar procesos internos.
Participar en visitas técnicas en campo y documentar información relevante del sitio, infraestructura, operación y oportunidades identificadas.
Apoyar la elaboración de propuestas técnico-económicas, casos de negocio, presentaciones comerciales y materiales para clientes.
Colaborar en actividades de seguimiento comercial, preparación de información para prospectos y soporte a iniciativas de Business Development.
Apoyar en la generación de contenido, materiales de marketing, casos de éxito, one-pagers o presentaciones que comuniquen el valor de las soluciones de S2G Energy.
Dar soporte a la gestión diaria de clientes, seguimiento a acciones, coordinación interna y comunicación clara de avances.
Proponer mejoras en procesos, análisis, reportes y materiales, buscando constantemente formas más eficientes de trabajar.




Requisitos

Esta es una vacante entry-level.
Ingeniería Eléctrica, Mecánica, Mecatrónica, Industrial, Energía o carreras afines.
Conocimientos técnicos en energía, infraestructura eléctrica, medición y eficiencia energética.
Inglés fluido.
Experiencia académica o profesional temprana en análisis energético, datos, proyectos técnicos, consultoría, ventas técnicas o desarrollo de negocio.
Familiaridad con herramientas como Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Query o similares. No se requiere dominio avanzado, pero sí interés por aprender y aplicarlas en problemas reales.
Interés genuino por el uso de inteligencia artificial, automatización, nuevas tecnologías y herramientas digitales para resolver problemas de negocio.
Capacidad para comunicar ideas técnicas de forma clara, tanto internamente como frente a clientes.
Perfil proactivo, rápido para ejecutar, adaptable y con disposición para involucrarse en temas técnicos, comerciales, de marketing y customer success.
Interés por desarrollar carrera en eficiencia energética, movilidad eléctrica, tecnología, IA y negocios de impacto.
Disponibilidad para trabajar de forma presencial en Anzures, CDMX.




Perfil Ideal

El candidato ideal es una persona con base técnica, curiosidad y alta energía para aprender. No necesita ser experto en todas las herramientas desde el inicio, pero sí debe tener iniciativa para aprender rápido, investigar, probar nuevas soluciones y apoyarse en tecnología e inteligencia artificial para trabajar de forma más eficiente.

Buscamos a alguien que no solo ejecute análisis, sino que también proponga mejoras, haga preguntas inteligentes, entienda el contexto de negocio del cliente y se involucre activamente en la generación de valor.

Debe sentirse cómodo trabajando en un rol versátil, donde un día puede apoyar en análisis energético o dashboards, y otro día en una propuesta comercial, una presentación para cliente, una visita técnica, un caso de éxito o una iniciativa de business development.

Valoramos especialmente a perfiles con mentalidad de crecimiento, rapidez de ejecución, buena comunicación, criterio para priorizar y entusiasmo por construir soluciones que conecten tecnología, energía y negocio.

 

Paquete de Compensación

Seguro de gastos médicos mayores
Compensación mensual bruta de $14,351.40 MXN
Bono anual por desempeño individual y del negocio
Prestaciones de ley




En S2G Energy creemos en el poder de la diversidad para impulsar la innovación y el impacto. Invitamos especialmente a postularse a personas pertenecientes a grupos históricamente subrepresentados en el sector tecnológico y energético. Si tu perfil no encaja al 100%, pero crees que puedes aportar a nuestra misión de transformar el uso de la energía a través de soluciones digitales, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Customer Engineering Team

Mixpanel's Customer Engineering teams are analytics consultants who embed themselves within our enterprise customer teams to drive business outcomes. We work with prospects and customers throughout the customer journey to understand what drives value, and serve as the technical counterpart to our Sales organisation to deliver on that value.

You will partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Value Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support to successfully roll out self-serve analytics within our customers' organisations, help manage change, execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers, and ultimately drive ROI on the customer's Mixpanel investment.

About The Role

Our Customer Engineers are inquisitive, nimble, and able to clearly articulate the technical benefits and requirements of Mixpanel to developers and product managers, while also communicating the business value of our product to senior executives.

In your first month, you'll become a Mixpanel expert—both in features and functionality as well as implementation. You'll shadow customer calls and demos with current Customer Engineers and Account Executives while learning to articulate our value proposition, and be trained on Mixpanel's internal systems and tools.

Within your first three months, you'll be directly involved in deal cycles with Account Executives. You'll lead the technical qualification for customer use cases and deliver customised demos for prospects and existing customers, working directly with leadership at the prospect's organisation to understand business challenges that can be solved through an analytics platform.

You'll also work with the prospect's business and technical teams to scope and execute proof-of-concept projects to establish Mixpanel's value—including consulting on data ingestion methods, overall architecture, success criteria, and rollout strategies for analytics tools across an organisation.

Responsibilities


Serve as a trusted technical advisor for prospects, providing strategic consultation on data architecture, governance, instrumentation, and business outcomes
Communicate and consult effectively at all levels of the customer's organisation to earn trust and influence buying decisions
Bridge the technical-business gap—working with senior stakeholders to define success for proofs-of-concept and ensuring successful execution and outcomes
Leverage your Mixpanel expertise and technical/consultative skills to impart best practices throughout proof-of-concept projects
Partner with Account Executives to drive revenue growth, serving as the key technical contact for customers

Develop relationships and uncover the needs of key technical stakeholders within your assigned book of business

You won't be doing it alone. You'll sit on top of a very capable team — PPC and Amazon strategists, creative, listing and data specialists, plus our internal AI ops agent (Viktor) — so your job is to own the relationship and the outcome, not to personally execute every task.



Requirements



What You'll Actually Do


Own a portfolio of 20-40 e-commerce brands end-to-end

You are the single point of accountability for client results and retention.
Run onboarding, set strategy, deliver results, retain the account — the full lifecycle.
2-hour response time during business hours, no exception.


Own onboarding like it decides the account — because it does

The first 30 days determine whether a client renews. We treat onboarding as strategy, not paperwork.
You set expectations, goals and the measurement plan before anyone touches a campaign.


Drive results, not reports

Analyze brand performance and profitability weekly.
Diagnose problems before the client notices them.
Translate numbers into clear, confident client communication.


Execute with precision

Build and follow structured processes for every account (audits, research, campaign architecture, optimization cycles)
Log every change. Document every decision. Nothing slips through the cracks.
Coordinate with your strategists daily — you own the relationship, they own execution, and both of you own the result.
Flag and escalate within hours, not days.


Operate at Trivium's pace

We don't do slow. Scaling decisions get 2-3 weeks to play out, then we adjust. Every week has a purpose.
When something breaks, you fix it the same day — no exceptions. If it can't be fixed the same day, it's escalated by EOD with a plan.
This is a high-volume Slack environment. You will need a real triage system — unread is your to-do list.
If performance is flat for 3 weeks, you're already pitching the strategic pivot


Who This Is For

3+ years of client-facing Client/Customer Success or Account Management experience at a digital, e-commerce or performance-marketing agency — or at a platform serving external paying clients. Managing e-commerce clients is required. Amazon agency experience is a bonus, not a requirement. Internal, single-brand account management does not count.
You've personally owned 20+ client accounts at the same time and didn't drop the ball.
Hands-on experience running or managing growth for e-commerce brands selling physical products — Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads or Amazon.
You're analytical: you think in efficiency and margin — ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, contribution profit — whichever platform you learned it on.
You're fast — you hate bottlenecks, you move things forward.
You're detailed — your reports don't have typos, your data is always current, your processes are documented.
You communicate with clarity and confidence — clients trust you because you know what you're talking about.
You take ownership — you don't say "that's not my job".
Fluent English (written and spoken — advanced level required).


Who This Is NOT For

You prefer a predictable, low-pressure environment.
You need to be told what to do every day.
You think "good enough" is good enough.
You avoid difficult conversations with clients.
You're not comfortable making decisions with imperfect data.
Your e-commerce experience is logistics, fulfillment or operations rather than marketing and advertising.
You've only managed one brand in-house, or a small number of enterprise accounts — we need an external, multi-client book.


Benefits




Compensation & Benefits

$4,000-$7,000/month (based on experience)
100% Remote
25 PTO days + 9 paid holidays
Professional development + direct mentorship from leadership
Join an 80+ person agency ranked Inc. 5000 #170, managing brands generating over $700 million in Amazon revenue


The Tools You'll Use

Slack, Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising Console, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, My Real Profit, Adlabs, ClickUp, and Viktor (our proprietary AI ops agent).


How to Stand Out

In your interview, tell us about a time you saved a client who was about to churn. What did you see? What did you do? What happened? We want specifics, not buzzwords.

description:
About The Role And Team

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. In this role, you will own the growth and success of a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, acting as their primary advisor to unlock the full potential of the Uber Eats platform. Burson es la agencia global líder en comunicación, diseñada para generar valor para los clientes a través de la reputación. Con equipos altamente especializados, tecnologías líderes en la industria y una creatividad innovadora, ayudamos a marcas y empresas a redefinir la reputación como ventaja competitiva para que puedan liderar hoy y en el futuro. Trabajar en Burson es formar parte de una comunidad global de profesionales comprometidos con el aprendizaje continuo y con liderar el cambio innovador.

Burson forma parte de WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), un referente mundial en transformación creativa. Para más información, visite bursonglobal.com y síganos en LinkedIn e Instagram.

Es nuestra política brindar igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todas las personas en función de las calificaciones relacionadas con el trabajo y la capacidad para realizar el mismo, sin distinción de edad, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, credo, origen nacional, discapacidad, información genética o estado civil, para mantener un entorno no discriminatorio libre de intimidación, acoso o prejuicio basado en estos motivos.

Tu Lugar Está En Burson

Nuestra visión es que Burson sea la principal ‘academy company’ para profesionales creativos de la comunicación y líderes emergentes. Ofrecemos un entorno dinámico donde los colaboradores vienen a potenciar sus habilidades, ampliar sus redes y, en última instancia, crear las mejores soluciones para las marcas líderes de hoy. Nuestro compromiso con su crecimiento se refleja en nuestros sólidos programas de beneficios y programas para el talento, que incluyen oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, programas de mentoría con líderes de la industria, una cultura apasionante e inclusiva que fomenta la colaboración y la innovación, así como programas para recompensar y retener a los mejores talentos. Invertimos en nuestra gente porque creemos que su éxito es nuestro éxito.

Burson es una agencia integrada por personas inspiradas en nunca dejar de aprender. Reconocemos que lo que mejor hacemos, la creatividad y la comunicación, requieren un nivel de entendimiento profundo y lleno de matices. Por eso es fundamental para nosotros contratar a personas extraordinariamente talentosas, con diversos contextos culturales e identidades. Sin ello, no podríamos realizar el trabajo esencial de inspirar las ideas más impactantes, fomentar diálogos constructivos, cultivar experiencias significativas e impulsar la innovación y la creatividad para nuestros socios. Tu perspectiva es única -tu talento- es lo que te convierte en un #BursonPerson, y es así como, en equipo, conseguimos resultados excepcionales para nuestros clientes.

You Belong At Burson

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

Como parte del conglomerado global Publicis Groupe, se especializa en innovar y conectar marcas con sus audiencias a través de campañas efectivas, datos y tecnología.




🦁 Sobre la posición

El Digital Implementation Specialist es responsable de asegurar la correcta implementación, activación, seguimiento y optimización de campañas digitales, transformando los media plans y lineamientos estratégicos en ejecuciones precisas dentro de las distintas plataformas.

El rol conecta planeación, activación, materiales, inversión y reporting, garantizando que las campañas estén correctamente configuradas, cuenten con una taxonomía consistente y mantengan trazabilidad durante todo su ciclo de ejecución.

Además de la implementación, buscamos un perfil con capacidad analítica para interpretar el desempeño de las campañas, identificar oportunidades de optimización y generar insights accionables a partir de los resultados.




🦁 Responsabilidades principales

Configurar, implementar, lanzar y monitorear campañas digitales principalmente en Meta Ads, TikTok Ads y Google.
Participar en la implementación de campañas en plataformas programáticas como DV360, Campaign Manager 360, Amazon DSP u otras similares.
Implementar campañas de acuerdo con los media plans, briefs, objetivos, presupuestos y KPIs establecidos.
Configurar correctamente campañas, ad sets/line items, audiencias, formatos, presupuestos, periodos de actividad, pujas y demás variables requeridas según cada plataforma.
Asegurar la correcta aplicación de naming conventions y taxonomías a nivel campaña, conjunto de anuncios/line item y creativo.
Realizar procesos de Quality Assurance (QA) antes y después de los lanzamientos, identificando posibles inconsistencias de configuración, presupuesto, segmentación, materiales o tracking.
Realizar y validar el tageo y tracking de campañas para garantizar su correcta medición.
Gestionar y validar los materiales creativos, asegurando que cumplan con las especificaciones y formatos requeridos por cada plataforma.
Monitorear pacing, inversión y KPIs, identificando oportunamente desviaciones entre lo planeado, implementado y ejecutado.
Proponer ajustes con base en el desempeño en términos de segmentación, pujas, inversión, ubicaciones y creatividades.
Trabajar con campañas enfocadas principalmente en objetivos de awareness y consideración.
Mantener consistencia y trazabilidad entre media plans, plataformas de activación y herramientas de reporting.
Apoyar en la generación y validación de reportes de performance semanales y mensuales, cierres y conciliaciones de inversión.
Analizar métricas y resultados para generar insights accionables y recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones.
Trabajar de manera coordinada con equipos de Planning, Performance, Data, partners y proveedores para garantizar una ejecución eficiente.




🦁 Para formar parte del #PowerOfOne requieres

Licenciatura en Comunicación, Publicidad, Marketing o carreras afines.
Experiencia mínima de 2 a 3 años en implementación, ejecución u optimización de campañas digitales.
Experiencia práctica en Meta Ads y TikTok Ads.
Conocimiento de Google y otras plataformas de activación digital.
Entendimiento de métricas digitales como Impressions, Reach, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPV, VTR y CPA/Conversions.
Conocimiento de procesos de media buying, trafficking, tracking y reporting.
Excel/Google Sheets intermedio-avanzado, incluyendo tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, análisis de datos y gráficos.
Capacidad para interpretar datos y convertirlos en insights y recomendaciones accionables.
Alta atención al detalle y orientación a QA y data quality.
Organización y capacidad para gestionar múltiples campañas y entregables simultáneamente.
Comunicación efectiva y habilidad para colaborar con distintos equipos y stakeholders.
Inglés básico funcional, principalmente para comprender plataformas, términos técnicos y documentación.

🦁 Será un plus contar con

Experiencia en Programmatic, especialmente en DV360, Campaign Manager 360, Amazon DSP u otras plataformas similares.
Conocimientos de media planning.
Experiencia trabajando tanto con Paid Social como con Google.
Experiencia en construcción y análisis de reportes ejecutivos de performance.

🦁 Lo que ofrecemos

En Publicis Groupe contamos con un paquete de prestaciones superiores a las de ley, además de un esquema de trabajo flexible:

30 días de aguinaldo.
12 días de vacaciones durante el primer año, con 25% de prima vacacional.
Vales de despensa

Seguro dental.
Seguro de vida.
Día libre por cumpleaños.
Apoyo de teletrabajo.
Modalidad híbrida, con asistencia presencial de 1 a 2 días por semana en Torre Diana.
Oportunidades de aprendizaje, desarrollo y crecimiento profesional dentro de un entorno dinámico y multidisciplinario.
Un ambiente de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y colaborativo.




🦁 Diversidad e inclusión

En Publicis Groupe valoramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno de trabajo inclusivo para todas las personas.

No discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, sexo, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, nacionalidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la ley.

Creemos que la diversidad impulsa la innovación y fortalece nuestros equipos. Por ello, promovemos la igualdad de oportunidades y tomamos nuestras decisiones de empleo con base en las capacidades, experiencia, mérito y necesidades del negocio, garantizando siempre un trato respetuoso y digno para colaboradores y candidatos.

ABM Manager at BairesDev

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

description:
About Rosenblum Law And Why This Role Exists

Rosenblum Law is a growth-focused consumer law firm with three practices: Estate Planning, Traffic Tickets (TrafficTickets.com), and Personal Injury. Our growth runs on technology: lead capture, call tracking, SMS and email nurture, paid acquisition, payments, and the project systems that keep cases moving.

That stack has grown tool by tool, with no single owner. Configuration lives in people's heads, integrations are stitched together with Zapier, and fixes happen reactively. We are hiring our first dedicated technology leader to own how our systems work and connect, make them reliable and documented, and turn them into a competitive advantage.

Role summary

Title

Head of Technology & Systems

Reports to

Chief Operating Officer

Works closely with

CEO, Chief Growth Officer, Managing Attorney, practice leads, sales and intake

Team

Individual contributor at start; may build a small team or manage contractors as the roadmap grows

Location: Remote

Type

Full-time

You will own how technology works and connects at the firm: the integrations, data flows, and architecture across every platform. Marketing platforms are run day to day by the growth team, and you'll support their maintenance and technical health. Half your time is hands-on: building automations, fixing integrations, configuring platforms, and supporting users. The other half is strategic: setting the architecture, choosing and retiring vendors, owning data and security, and building a roadmap leadership can fund and track.

The environment you'll own

You inherit a modern SaaS stack of roughly 15 platforms, with no on-premise infrastructure to speak of. The work is integration, data, automation, and governance.

Category

Platforms

What They Do For Us

CRM

FileMaker Pro

The firm's CRM: client and matter records, the system of record for client data

Marketing automation & lead nurture

ActiveCampaign, Loops

Email and automation journeys, lead and deal pipelines

Shared intake & communications

CallTrackingMetrics, Sakari

Paid social, search visibility, landing pages and lead forms

ClickUp

PMO, practice workflows, capacity planning

Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs), Slack

Email, files, scheduling, internal communication

Payments & finance

Stripe, ACH payment workflows

Client payments; ACH validation and bank verification improvements in flight

Workforce

Hubstaff; payroll and contractor platforms (Gusto, Payoneer under review)

Time tracking, payroll, international contractor payments

Automation & AI

Zapier, Claude, AI dictation tools

Cross-system workflows, AI-assisted work

Who owns what: FileMaker Pro is the firm's CRM, and you will own it outright, including its configuration, data quality, and integrations. CallTrackingMetrics and Sakari are shared intake and communications systems used by marketing, sales, and intake, and you will own them outright. The marketing platforms (ActiveCampaign, Loops, Meta Ads, and the firm websites) are owned day to day by the growth team; you own their integrations and support their maintenance. You own all other platforms.

Known work already on the table: the CRM migration project; documenting the ActiveCampaign, CallTrackingMetrics, and Sakari configuration and integrations; restructuring the ClickUp workspace; fixing recurring ACH bounces with a validated payment form and bank verification; and evaluating contractor payment platforms.

Set and enforce standards for security, access, data retention, and client confidentiality appropriate to a law firm.

description:
About The Role

We're looking for a creative, highly strategic storyteller who understands what captures people's attention on social media and knows how to turn that attention into engaging, shareable content.

You understand that successful social media videos aren't just about following trends or making entertaining clips. They're about understanding human psychology, knowing what makes people stop scrolling, creating curiosity, building emotional connections, and keeping viewers hooked until the very end.

You have a natural ability to recognize what makes a video compelling. You can watch a viral video and break down exactly why it works — from the opening hook and storytelling structure to the pacing, emotional triggers, and unexpected moments.

More importantly, you know how to take those insights and recreate that magic through original content.

Key Responsibilities:


 Storytelling & Audience Psychology


Develop compelling stories that capture attention and keep viewers watching.

Understand what makes people curious, entertained, surprised, emotionally invested, or compelled to share.

Identify powerful hooks and opening lines that make people stop scrolling within the first 1-3 seconds.

Turn ordinary products, experiences, and everyday situations into interesting stories.

Use storytelling techniques such as curiosity gaps, suspense, humor, conflict, unexpected twists, and relatable situations.

Know how to build anticipation and deliver satisfying payoffs that keep viewers watching until the end.


 Viral Content Research & Analysis


Study viral videos across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.

Identify why certain videos attract millions of views while others struggle to get attention.

Break down successful videos to understand their hooks, storytelling, emotional triggers, editing, pacing, and audience appeal.

Recognize viral content patterns and identify opportunities to adapt them for BuzzyBooth.

Stay ahead of emerging trends and understand which ones are worth recreating.


 Creative Strategy & Content Development


Generate original video concepts designed to capture attention and encourage sharing.

Transform everyday BuzzyBooth customer experiences into entertaining and engaging stories.

Develop scripts, hooks, storyboards, and creative briefs for short-form videos.

Create multiple variations of successful concepts to test different angles and storytelling approaches.

Make branded content feel entertaining and natural rather than like traditional advertisements.

Understand how to tailor content for different audiences and social media platforms.


 Content Performance & Optimization


Analyze video retention, watch time, completion rates, shares, comments, and engagement.

Identify where viewers lose interest and how to improve storytelling.

Test different hooks, opening scenes, storylines, and video formats.

Learn from both successful and unsuccessful videos.

Develop repeatable creative strategies that consistently improve content performance.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Exceptional storytelling instincts and creativity.

A deep understanding of human psychology and what captures people's attention.
